objective: Read local producer and Plugin files, verify read-only mounts, and write fixed artifacts.

worker.instructions:
Run the script below with anchor_run using command=["sh","-c",script]. Read and follow the printed Plugin skill; no external research. After exit 0, call final_result with summary="producer and Plugin verified", route="verify". Do not repeat a successful command.
set -eu
test ! -e report.txt; test ! -e effects.txt
printf 'producer input:\n'; cat /in/producer/source.txt
printf 'Plugin skill:\n'; cat /plugins/regression/skills/check/SKILL.md
printf 'Plugin resource:\n'; cat /plugins/regression/resources/input.txt
printf 'seed\n' | cmp - /in/producer/source.txt
printf 'fixture-resource\n' | cmp - /plugins/regression/resources/input.txt
for path in /in/producer/source.txt /plugins/regression/skills/check/SKILL.md /plugins/regression/resources/input.txt; do
  if (: >> "$path") 2>/dev/null; then printf 'ERROR writable: %s\n' "$path"; exit 1; fi
  printf 'read-only verified: %s\n' "$path"
done
if (: > /plugins/regression/readonly-probe.txt) 2>/dev/null; then printf 'ERROR Plugin directory writable\n'; exit 1; fi
printf 'Plugin directory read-only verified\n'
cat /in/producer/source.txt /plugins/regression/resources/input.txt > report.txt
printf 'once\n' > effects.txt
printf 'report:\n'; cat report.txt
printf 'effects:\n'; cat effects.txt

verify.run:

fixture-resource
" | cmp - /in/worker/report.txt; printf "once
" | cmp - /in/worker/effects.txt; if (: >> /in/producer/source.txt) 2>/dev/null; then printf "ERROR producer input writable
"; exit 1; fi; printf "bytes and producer read-only verified
